description: Live availability check for a SKU: whether it can be bought now and how many units can be ordered. Fresher than the stock_level on product results, which can be hours old.

sku.description: Product SKU exactly as shown on the site.

name: get_stock_level

stock_level.description: Units that can be ordered now (the figure the basket caps quantities at); null when not reported.

warehouse_quantity.description: Units physically in the London warehouse, including ones sold but not yet dispatched. 0 for items shipped direct from a supplier, so do not read 0 as out of stock: use available and stock_level.

title: Get stock level
